entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's a_customer@example.com. The order was from about a week ago.
Thank you. I see your recent order for the Pro-Series Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
Okay, I understand. When you say the jersey is the wrong size, is it too large, or perhaps too tight?
It's way too tight. I can't even zip it up properly. Your sizing charts must be off.

I'm sorry to hear it didn't fit as expected. The good news is that for apparel like a jersey, we have a 90-day return and exchange policy. Since you received it just 8 days ago, you are well within that window. We can process a full refund or an exchange for a different size. Which would you prefer?
Whatever. I guess an exchange makes sense.

Excellent. I can set up that exchange for you right now. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label to send back the original jersey. As soon as our warehouse scans it in, we'll ship out the new size to you. What size would you like to get instead?
A large. Just send the email.
Alright. I have just initiated that for you. The email with the label is on its way to your inbox. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit. We appreciate your business. Have a good rest of your day.
